name: Agent Session History
description: Reads a session's history exactly as stored, by position: user and assistant turns, tool calls, tool results in full, unanswered turns, diagnostics and compaction summaries. Position 0 is the oldest entry and entries[i] is at start + i. With no range you get the newest entries; to go further back, pass the returned start as end. If next is present, the range was longer than limit: pass next as start to continue. A summary marked [Compacted: turns a–b] stands for positions a to b, so read those with start=a and end=b+1. A summary among them names its own range, read the same way. limit counts entries and each entry comes back whole, so a long tool result comes back at full length. An agent may omit agentId to read itself, and omitting sessionId then reads the session it is in; an owner or authorised caller supplies agentId, and omitting sessionId then reads the newest visible session. Missing sessions and sessions hidden by venue policy return exactly {found:false}.

agentId.description: Optional target agent id or g/<id> path. Omit only from that agent's own execution context. Reading an explicit target requires agent read access.

sessionId.description: Optional 16-byte hex session id, with or without a 0x prefix. Omit for the session you are in, or outside a session for the newest visible one.

start.description: Position of the first entry to read. Omit with end for the newest entries.

end.description: Position to stop before: this entry is not included. Alone, reads the newest limit entries before it.

contextStart.description: Position where the entries now in the agent's context begin. Earlier entries are outside it, standing behind compaction summaries.

start.description: Position of the first entry returned.

end.description: End of the range read, not included.

next.description: Present when the range was longer than limit: the position to continue from.
